output.question: What is Tonix Pharmaceuticals' short interest?
output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, the latest available short-interest figures for Tonix Pharmaceuticals Holding Corp. (NASDAQ: TNXP) show 3,318,461 shares sold short, representing 19.42% of its float, for the October 30, 2026 settlement date. That was up 12.85% from October 15, with a reported days-to-cover ratio of 4.14. ([chartexchange.com](https://chartexchange.com/symbol/nasdaq-tnxp/short-interest/))
